hints.content:
The greatest common factor of $12k^3$ and $-30k^4$ is $6k^3$.

[[☃ explanation 1]]

Now we need to factor $6k^3$ out of $12k^3 - 30k^4$.

options.explanation:
We find the prime factors of each term:

$\begin{align}
12k^3&=\blueD{(2)}(2)\maroonD{(3)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}
\\\\
-30k^4&=(-1)\blueD{(2)}\maroonD{(3)}(5)\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}(k)
\end{align}$

The greatest common factor is the product of all the shared parts:

$\blueD{(2)}\maroonD{(3)}\goldD{(k)(k)(k)}=6k^3$
